meta.coverage_note: Collection is restricted to schools in the top 50 of at least one source ranking, including ties. PhD origins are unrestricted. Jobs outside the collection sample contribute no placement credit. Top-3 destination weights are unadjusted whole article counts divided by the publication-window length, averaged across available ASU/UTD sources. ASU covers 2016–2025 and UTD covers 2017–2026 (partial 2026), both JF/JFE/RFS. There is no faculty-size or reference-school scaling and no further research-rank cutoff. Alternative scores use each source’s top 100, including ties, and normalize to Wharton; the UTD alternative uses its Score column, while Top-3s/year uses its Articles column. Missing research counts give zero Top-3 credit without excluding alternative scores. Program scores sum graduate contributions with self placements capped at one-quarter of the Top-3 total; alternative scores inherit that proportional adjustment. Within this sample, 2795 complete PhD records are supplied as verified among 3208 submitted faculty. Source and verification labels reflect supplied evidence; career histories and primary/tenure status may be incomplete.

geography_metadata.policy: Countries follow supplied QS country/territory data where available. Cities use reviewed ROR institution matches, main-campus choices, or official institutional contact/history pages. Doctoral units inherit the containing institution location unless a separately reviewed campus location is supplied. Ambiguous names/campuses and synthetic demo institutions are explicitly flagged; no city is invented.

The search-indexed title page of the university-hosted dissertation names University of Southern Queensland, Yinshuo Xu, the exact environmental-risks/bank-loan dissertation title, and submission for the Doctor of Philosophy in the School of Accounting, Economics and Finance, Faculty of Business and Law. input_validation.score_column: Subject Score; Global Score was not used
input_validation.current_alternative_weights: All active top-50 rows reconcile to the supplied page text. No numerical changes required.

input_validation.note: The author-supplied 300-row table uses the previously confirmed 2017–2026 JF/JFE/RFS query. The 2026 endpoint is partial at this snapshot.
input_validation.input_metric: Articles column for Top-3s/year; Score column for the UTD alternative ranking
input_validation.rank_basis: Provider displayed ranks retained for collection/alternative cutoff membership.
input_validation.current_top3_weights: Available article counts / 10; no faculty-size, reference-school, or research-rank adjustment.

policies.rank_bands: Use band midpoint as x and set rank_is_estimated to true.
policies.score_bands: Use band midpoint before normalization and set score_is_estimated to true.
policies.score_anchors: Use the rank-1 score and rank-100 score. When ties skip rank 100, use the 100th school in rank order.
policies.missing_scores: Ignore up to two missing sources; impute zero for each additional missing source. Divide the sum by max(available source count, total source count - 2). If none are available, publish zero.
policies.negative_scores: Preserve negative values below the rank-100 score; do not clamp.
policies.unranked_schools: Use the same missing-source rule for unranked schools: ignore up to two gaps, then impute zero.
policies.school_identity: Resolve every input name through school_name_dictionary.json; unmapped names fail the import.
policies.duplicate_school_in_source: Use the better-ranked record once; never sum overlapping affiliation totals.
policies.source_count: Number of available scores for score weighted; number of ranked sources for ranking weighted.
policies.asu_totals: One whole-period total per school, checked against supplied yearly counts. Blank yearly counts do not determine the score.
policies.confidentiality: Original ranks, source scores, raw rows, and source snapshots are excluded.

ranking_options.label: Top-3s/year at destination
ranking_options.formula: Sum graduates' destination-school top-three articles per year, averaging available ASU/UTD article counts; cap self-placement contribution at external contribution / 3.

legacy_import_metadata.description: Retained import-stage transforms only; not the current program or alternative-source scoring formulas.
legacy_import_metadata.active_policy: program_ranking_metadata; destination_inputs contains the final Top-3 destination weights.

school_model.parent_school_id: Null for an institution; otherwise the parent unit's school_id.
school_model.aliases: Names identifying the exact program unit, such as HBS. Used at the program stage.
school_model.display_order: Order among siblings within the same parent.

policies.scoring_stage: Use unadjusted whole top-three finance journal articles divided by each source publication-window length. Average available ASU and UTD annual counts at each destination; sum across graduates. No faculty-size or reference-school scaling, and no further research-rank cutoff.
policies.input_scores: One observed selected appointment per graduate, using the agreed combined destination-score options.
policies.program_membership: Use completed PhD roles. Include the faculty member in the exact unit and each ancestor, once per unit.
policies.university_result: Sum destination weights; cap self-placement score at external score / 3, hence one-quarter of the total.
policies.subschool_result: Sum that unit’s graduates in the same unscaled articles-per-year units. Include each graduate once in university totals.
policies.missing_scores: Average available ASU/UTD annual article counts, including a documented zero. Use one source in full or zero if neither is available. Collection is the union of all source top 50s; alternative comparisons retain each source top 100.
policies.display: Keep universities above 0.25 on the last-10-years Top-3 total. For every sort column, show at most 100 universities ranked within that metric’s top 100; select results using the active metric, then apply the display cap. Attach the configured doctoral subunits below their parent, in lighter text.
policies.unknown_unit: Keep a university-only affiliation at the university level; do not guess a subschool.
policies.joint_doctorates: A joint doctorate is one PhD role with origin_affiliations whose credit_weight values sum to one. Split placement contributions equally among the documented partner institutions. Count the faculty member once in overall graduate totals.
policies.cohorts: Default to the last 10 PhD cohorts; also report the last 20 cohorts and All. All includes sourced undated doctoral records with an identified, unambiguous institution, including records marked uncertain. Dated uncertain PhDs and explicitly ambiguous institutions remain excluded. Preserve supplied verification labels.
policies.subscore_display: For university rows, rank each selected-window source placement total across the selected origin universe. Display #1 through #100, then - for ranks above 100. Suppress all alternative rankings when the university has fewer than three total tracked graduates across all years, regardless of source or selected period. Subunit subscore cells are blank. Top-3 score columns retain numeric totals.
policies.appointments: Exclude visiting, postdoctoral, teaching-only, courtesy, emeritus, honorary, practice, explicitly non-primary, actuarial-science, future, and ended jobs. For simultaneous eligible current jobs, select the highest Top-3 destination score, once per graduate; ties use primary status, start year, and stable role ID.
policies.separate_doctorates: Keep separate completed doctorate records and credit only the latest award, using its institution and graduation year. Do not split credit between separate degrees. Unknown ordering or unresolved latest-award ties remain for review. Genuine documented joint awards retain their split-credit treatment.
policies.finance_unit_scope: Require an appointment in a finance department or university finance institute. A documented university finance research center qualifies as a finance institute. Research interests or SFI network membership alone are insufficient. Preserve known outside-unit appointments as data but exclude them from placement scoring and qualifying headcounts.

collection_sample.policy: Collect faculty appointments at universities ranked in the top 50 of at least one source, including ties. Exclude other jobs before placement selection. PhD origins are unrestricted. Within the collection use all available ASU/UTD article counts for Top-3 scores; alternative comparisons retain their source top 100.

normalization.label: Wharton
normalization.policy: Top-3 scores are unscaled articles per year. Alternative comparison scores divide by Wharton in the same source.
normalization.formula: composite = mean(available ASU articles / ASU years, UTD articles / UTD years), or 0 if neither is available; no reference-school or faculty-size adjustment

self_placements.policy: Self placements contribute at most one-quarter of the total score. Apply a proportional cap of external score / 3 within each university and cohort. Source comparisons and subunits inherit this factor; counts are unchanged.

composite_policy.missing_component_policy: Average available annual article counts; use one in full or zero if neither is available.
composite_policy.article_count_basis: Unadjusted whole articles: ASU Total and UTD Articles. UTD Score is used only for the UTD alternative ranking.

source_comparisons.policy: Sum placement contributions using each source’s own top 100, including ties. Divide raw scores by Wharton’s score. The UTD alternative uses its authorship-weighted Score column; only Top-3s/year uses its Articles column. Outside-source-top-100 destinations contribute zero. Inherit the Top-3 total’s proportional self-placement adjustment.

destination_faculty_size_adjustment.policy: No faculty-size adjustment in the articles-per-year draft.

minimum_cell_size.suppression_text: Censored due to minimum cell size suppression

destination_sample.tie_policy: Use available source counts within the collection sample, without a further research-rank cutoff.
